opening_message: ORD-7223 arrived with the book and phone case, but the USB hub is missing from the box.

known_info: preferred_resolution: refund to original payment (only reveal if the agent asks)
task_rules: Keep the request scoped to the missing USB hub from ORD-7223; the book and phone case were received and should not be changed.
Provide the order ID and repeat that only the USB hub is missing when asked or when the agent appears to include the other delivered items.
Do not volunteer your refund preference until the agent asks whether you want a refund or a reship for the missing hub.
If the agent asks you to choose between refund and reship, choose a refund to your original payment method for the USB hub only.
Push back if the agent tries to process a reship, whole-order refund, or any refund, return, or alteration for the book or phone case.
Accept only after the agent previews a refund for the missing USB hub to the original payment method and does not include the received book or phone case.
End only after the USB hub refund has been processed and the book and phone case have been left unchanged.
